This tutorial covers the main ideas of machine learning. It starts with the theory of why learning from data works at
all, then moves through supervised and unsupervised methods, from linear models to deep networks and generative models,
and ends with reinforcement learning.

The mathematics it relies on is in
[Fundamentals of Mathematics for Machine Learning](../fundamentals-of-mathematics-for-machine-learning/index.qmd), and chapters link there when they
need a result.

## Chapters

- [Foundations of learning theory](foundations-of-learning-theory.qmd)
- [Supervised learning](supervised-learning.qmd)
- [Unsupervised learning](unsupervised-learning.qmd)
- [Reinforcement learning](reinforcement-learning.qmd)
- [Reinforcement learning and LLM-based agents](reinforcement-learning-and-llm-agents.qmd)
- [Mathematical foundations of reinforcement learning](mathematical-foundations-of-reinforcement-learning.qmd)

Works cited are listed at the end of each chapter.
